title: Treat the November escrow release as a disposition event, preserve provider timebases, and quarantine privileged main writers through a fresh-main PR
context: XRP Insights reports two EscrowFinish transactions at 00:00:02 UTC and 1B XRP net outside escrow by validated ledger 108036051 at 02:31 UTC.
Destination fields and subsequent economic disposition remain unverified.
Liqwall and OKX report close but provider-scoped XRP price observations at different times; derivatives universes must remain separate.

Binance's official Recovery Update #3 reports 90% aggregate replenishment and 100% XRP/RLUSD customer-asset backing, but the full ZK PoR proof is estimated for November 3 and XRP-specific purchases are undisclosed.
Current main retains write-capable Cross Analysis, Scheduler Tick and Merge Queue workflows.
PR #1439 is now diverged 1 ahead/1 behind current main. A fresh-main successor #1441 was created and its CI and fail-closed gate passed.

decisions.decision: Do not infer sell pressure, exchange deposits, OTC sale or beneficial ownership from the 1B XRP gross release.
decisions.reason: Destination and follow-on transaction evidence are missing.

decisions.decision: Store tracker ledger time, market provider observation time, publication time and research capture time as separate fields.
decisions.reason: A fresh page retrieval can expose a stale pinned ledger or stale rolling market window.

decisions.decision: Keep Liqwall and OKX observations provider-scoped and pending source-registry ingestion; do not average open interest or funding across incompatible provider universes.
decisions.reason: Coverage and methodology are not yet reconciled.

decisions.decision: Treat Binance's XRP/RLUSD 100% backing as a company claim pending full cryptographic PoR and asset/liability reconciliation.
decisions.reason: Aggregate coverage and XRP-specific market purchases are different quantities.

decisions.decision: Keep forecast_status NOT_ISSUED and market_features_admitted false until raw escrow transaction metadata, destination, subsequent disposition and synchronized market data are verified.
decisions.reason: No validated predictive signal or event-study design is yet available.

decisions.decision: Use PR #1441 as the fresh-main safety candidate; keep #1439 and #1441 unmerged pending explicit approval.
decisions.reason: PR #1439 diverged after main advanced; #1441 is based on current main and exact-head CI/gate passed.

decisions.decision: Do not enable scheduled knowledge ingestion or promote generated artifacts directly to main until durable deduplication, freshness guards, source provenance and a least-privilege publisher are implemented.
decisions.reason: Main currently has zero-sample sentiment output with a new generated_at timestamp.

ingestion_contract.freshness_rule: Freshness is computed from source_data_cutoff_utc or validated_ledger_time_utc, never from generated_at alone.
ingestion_contract.source_independence: Publisher, underlying exchange/chain dataset, collection method and common upstream dependency must be recorded; syndicated copies are not independent corroboration.
ingestion_contract.market_feature_admission: Require immutable source registry membership, non-null observation timestamp, provider scope, units, quality checks, point-in-time cutoff and explicit missingness handling.
ingestion_contract.event_study: Use event-time windows around EscrowFinish; separate release, destination receipt, transfers, exchange deposits, sales and re-escrow; include BTC/ETH controls and market-wide covariates; avoid overlapping future data.
ingestion_contract.prediction_contract: Every forecast requires target, horizon, data cutoff, assumptions, probability/confidence, alternatives, baseline, model version, calibration state and later outcome.
ingestion_contract.live_trading: Shadow/paper evaluation only until walk-forward performance, calibration, drift and execution controls are independently reviewed.

platform_coordination.current_chatgpt_session: ACTIVE_CONVERSATION_CONTEXT; not a separate external connector authentication
platform_coordination.rule: Use independent task assignments, structured evidence packets, provenance, disagreement retention and red-team review; no live collaboration claim without successful authenticated test.

supersedes_decision: Earlier pre-release and post-eligibility status decisions remain preserved; this decision updates the evidence cutoff and fresh-main PR status without rewriting historical records.
